# blanks-around-fences

- ID: `MD031`
- Category: Code
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: yes
- Tags: `code`, `blank_lines`

Fenced code blocks have a blank or comment line above and below.

## Why

Some parsers, such as kramdown, do not recognize a fenced code block without the
blank lines.

## Options

Set them under `rules.blanks-around-fences.options`.

- `list_items` (`boolean`, default `true`): Check fenced code blocks in list
  items too.

## Fix

The fix inserts the missing blank line, keeping any blockquote markers. gomdlint
reports some fences without a fix, such as a fence in a tight list when the
blank line would make the list loose. gomdlint may report a finding without a
fix when the fix would change a line with one character in brackets, such as
\[x\] or \[1\], or the lines around it up to a blank line, because it could add
or remove a task list checkbox.

## Configure

```yaml
rules:
  blanks-around-fences:
    options:
      list_items: true
```

Under `rules`, `blanks-around-fences: false` turns the rule off and
`blanks-around-fences: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable blanks-around-fences` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line blanks-around-fences -->
```
